title: Locality-Aware Redundancy Pruning for LLM Depth Compression
abstract: arXiv:2605.27786v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models are known to contain representational redundancy across network depth, making depth pruning an effective approach for improving inference efficiency. Existing one-shot pruning methods rely on local layer importance or fixed redundancy assumptions across architectures. We propose Locality-Aware Redundancy Pruning (LoRP), a training-free one-shot depth pruning framework guided by representation locality. We show that inter-layer redundancy can be either localized or globally distributed depending on the LLM architecture. To characterize this phenomenon, we introduce Representation Locality Score (RLS), derived from global inter-layer hidden-state similarity. Using a small calibration set, LoRP computes pairwise layer similarity, clusters layers by representational similarity, and allocates pruning according to residual intra-cluster redundancy. Experiments across diverse LLM families show improvements in bot

translated_title: 面向大语言模型深度压缩的局部性感知冗余剪枝
translated_abstract: 大语言模型被普遍认为在网络深度上存在表征冗余，这使得深度剪枝成为提升推理效率的有效方法。现有的一次性剪枝方法依赖于局部层级重要性或跨架构的固定冗余假设。我们提出了局部性感知冗余剪枝，这是一个由表征局部性指导的免训练一次性深度剪枝框架。我们证明了层间冗余根据大语言模型架构的不同，既可以呈局部化分布，也可以呈全局分布。为了刻画这一现象，我们引入了表征局部性分数，该分数由全局层间隐状态相似性推导而来。利用一个小型校准集，LoRP计算层间两两相似度，按表征相似性对层进行聚类，并根据簇内剩余冗余来分配剪枝。在多个大语言模型家族上的实验显示出……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种免训练的一次性深度剪枝框架LoRP，通过表征局部性分数（RLS）刻画大语言模型中层间冗余的分布特性（局部或全局），并据此自适应地分配层级剪枝，从而在提升推理效率的同时保持模型性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LoRP, a training-free one-shot depth pruning framework that introduces a Representation Locality Score (RLS) to characterize whether inter-layer redundancy is localized or globally distributed across LLM architectures, enabling adaptive layer pruning for improved inference efficiency.
